items.stem: Complete the statement: The main purpose of a control account is to …
options: check the arithmetical accuracy of a ledger
items.answer: check the arithmetical accuracy of a ledger
items.markingKey: check the arithmetical accuracy of a ledger. Total of individual balances should equal the control balance [1]

items.stem: Explain two benefits of keeping control accounts.
items.answer: They check the accuracy of each ledger so errors are located quickly; totals of receivables and payables are available quickly for the trial balance; they act as a check against fraud if kept by a different person.
items.markingKey: Any two benefits with explanation [1 each] [2]

items.stem: Explain why the allowance for doubtful debts is not entered in the sales ledger control account.
items.answer: It is an estimate that does not relate to any individual customer's account, so it is not in the sales ledger; the control account must agree with the ledger total.
items.markingKey: Not in individual accounts [1]; control must agree with ledger [1] [2]

items.answer: (a) (i) sales ledger control account – credit; (ii) sales ledger control account – credit; (iii) neither control account; (iv) purchases ledger control account – debit; (v) purchases ledger control account – credit; (vi) debit purchases ledger control, credit sales ledger control (b) It summarises all transactions with credit customers so its balance can be checked against the total of the individual customer balances, locating errors and deterring fraud.

items.stem: Explain why a contra entry is made.
items.answer: When a business owes a supplier who is also its customer, the amounts are set off so that only the net amount is paid, saving cash transfers.
items.markingKey: Same person customer and supplier [1]; net settlement [1] [2]

items.stem: Explain why errors in the books of prime entry affect the control account but not the individual ledger accounts.
items.answer: Control accounts are written up from the totals of the books of prime entry, while individual accounts are posted from each line; a casting error affects only the total.
